title: Das Cabinet des Dr. Caligari (The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari), 1920, Robert Wiene
cut: 15:40-18:55 of the archive copy, black border cropped (crop=560:424:38:22)
contents: Caligari wakes the somnambulist Cesare, who opens his eyes; Alan asks 'How long do I have to live?' and Cesare answers 'Till dawn tomorrow'.
